_readme: Copy this file to install.json next to submission_helper.py / SubmissionHelper.exe and fill it in.
install.json is ignored by git: keep real API keys there, never in this example.
Empty values are not used: tools are then found on PATH or by the SH_FFPROBE, SH_FFMPEG,
SH_OIIOTOOL, SH_AYON, SH_OCIO, DEADLINE_PATH, FTRACK_* and AYON_* environment variables.
Paths starting with ./ are relative to the app folder; on Windows .exe is added to tool paths.
_comment_tools: Executables. A path that doesn't exist is ignored.
_comment_ocio: OCIO config for oiiotool; the GUI Preferences path overrides it when enabled.
_comment_presets: Shared presets folder for the whole studio instead of the per user folder.
_comment_ftrack: ftrack connection. Older install.json files may use server_url / api_user / api_key, those still work.
